high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing on a balcony or terrace, holding a large Indian flag. The flag is prominently displayed in the foreground, featuring the traditional tricolor of orange (saffron), white, and green, with the Ashoka Chakra in the center of the white stripe. The person appears to be dressed in a traditional outfit, possibly a dhoti and a shawl, and is wearing a cap. They are standing behind a railing, which suggests they are on an upper level of a building. The background shows a section of a building with a window covered by curtains.
